title: Noir LSP Doc Symbols
tagline: Implemented textDocument/documentSymbol for nargo/noir LSP in the main noir repo's LSP crate
description: This project implements the `textDocument/documentSymbol` request implementation. It provides all the symbols in provided source file. The project uses `noirc_frontend`'s parser to parse the source files and return document symbols. This is used in vscode to provide the outline part of the code.
how_its_made:
It implements and serves a new request type `textDocument/documentSymbols` for the noir LSP. It extracts source's document symbols by using the noirc_frontend's parser to parse and return symbols in a given document.

This is used in vscode to provide the outline part of the code. It even allows to jump on the given symbols directly. But I am yet to return the ranges, it should be a simple byte offset to line/col conversion.
